notes: The verifier gives partial credit for rows recovered, and the real work is walking SQLite's page/cell/varint layout by hand because sqlite3 will not open a truncated file. I scored on that, not on 'mentions sqlite'. TMax carries this one: it has both halves - genuine corrupted-SQLite/WAL recovery (000117 with the overwritten header is the closest single item after 000419) and hand-rolled binary-record carving (000419 is the best skill match in the whole pool). RTS has no SQLite corruption at all; its SQLite tasks are all healthy-database setup/export, so I leaned on its steganography/binary-carving chain and ELF-header-parsing families instead, and ranks 7-10 there are weak on skill and only hold the SQLite domain. A caution for the merge: several RTS 'export every table of db.sqlite to JSON' variants (005464bc, 90ce9e50, 36863e87) and tw_326975 are the same Chinook task and will look strong lexically for this TB id because the output is JSON-from-SQLite - they teach nothing about recovery, and I scored them 2. SWE-Rebench's d0c-s4vage/pfp cluster is a binary-template interpreter and is the only place in that corpus where struct-by-struct binary walking is the crux; note it also appears in my schemelike-metacircular-eval file, for a different reason (evaluator semantics).
